description: This file defines the interface 'RepeatingCustomValueDescriptor' in the org.openmrs.customdatatype package, describing behavior and constraints for custom values that can repeat within an owning type in the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: RepeatingCustomValueDescriptor
classes.description: An interface that extends CustomValueDescriptor, providing methods to specify the minimum and maximum number of times a custom value can repeat within its owner.

methods.name: getMinOccurs
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of values of this type that must be present for the owner to be valid. Implementations should never return null. Positive values indicate a required minimum.

methods.name: getMaxOccurs
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of values of this type that may be present for the owner to be valid. Implementation should never return a number less than or equal to zero.
